findings.issue: A machine-level Codex receipt changed capture routing in unrelated OpenCode worktrees.
findings.disposition: Use private admission for physical worktrees and their descendants.

findings.issue: Tests did not fully establish protected worker identity across handoff or prior-protocol rejection.
findings.disposition: Assert distinct PIDs, matching native build, sweep progress, and retained ledger and response on rejection.

findings.issue: Independent OpenCode coverage initially stopped at callback registration.
findings.disposition: The native-manager fixture binds an SQLite-backed session and verifies its 47 input tokens in the independent ledger.

findings.issue: The protected generator could re-read a different operational state path after worker validation.
findings.disposition: The writer validates and acquires the same canonical state and guards the lock and journal. Protected workers require protocol 2.

findings.issue: First admission could drop a callback in an unrelated worktree during global lease contention.
findings.disposition: Lock physical worktree boundaries so sibling callbacks can proceed during first admission.

findings.issue: Explicit reconcile after upgrade skipped queued bindings until a native callback.
findings.disposition: Reconcile verifies and admits the configured protected installation before recovering the queued response.

findings.issue: An interrupted uninstall exposed an inactive receipt before the journal committed.
findings.disposition: A pending journal blocks release and protected worktree markers persist through committed cleanup.

findings.issue: Automatic publication stopped on different display titles for the same ticket ID.
findings.disposition: Use the accepted ledger title under the publication lock and treat registration titles as display hints.

findings.issue: A cached snapshot without a user caused the writer to roll back valid sibling publication.
findings.disposition: Preserve the invalid cache as opaque and recover only from a verified source read.

findings.issue: Pre-binding reconciliation created native snapshots with a blank user.

reporters.identity_note: Native tester inherited the requested coordinator profile.

findings.disposition: Read the selected Git identity within the worker pass deadline.
